topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the introductory framing, course background, and learning outcomes for the lecture series.

topics.label: Carcinogenesis, cellular differentiation, and tissue architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops as a failure of cellular differentiation and tissue architecture driven by accumulated genetic and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Pathology and progression of tumor invasion and metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the histopathological hallmarks, mechanisms, and stepwise progression of tumor invasion and metastasis distinguishing benign from malignant lesions.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature, classification, and pathophysiological impacts
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the naming conventions for tumors and the pathophysiological mechanisms through which benign and malignant growths cause patient morbidity and mortality.

topics.label: Cancer incidence and comparative oncology across species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze epidemiological patterns of cancer incidence in human populations and compare tumor occurrence across diverse animal taxa.

topics.label: Cancer presentation, screening strategies, and diagnostic histology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the clinical presentation of tumors and the rationale, histological methods, and efficacy of population-level screening programs.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and housekeeping
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the administrative wrap-up, revisits the learning outcomes, and concludes the lecture.
